rationale: The `registrarBoleto` function (L57–L104) contains a C1 TIME_NOW vulnerability. At L73, `time.Now()` is called and assigned to `notExpiredDate`, then at L74 the current time is formatted and written to `objBoleto.DataVencimento`. This value is subsequently marshaled and written to the ledger via `APIstub.PutState(args[0], boletoAsBytes)` at L103. Since `time.Now()` returns different values across endorsing peers (even microseconds apart), different peers will write different `DataVencimento` values for the same transaction, causing endorsement divergence. Additionally, L72 uses `rand.Intn()` multiple times to generate `CodigoBarra`, which is also nondeterministic and written to the ledger, compounding the consensus failure.
